title: Einbürgerungstest 2026: 33 Questions, 17 to Pass
excerpt: How the German citizenship test works, where the questions come from and how to prepare.
description: How the German citizenship test (Einbürgerungstest) works: 33 questions in 60 minutes, 17 correct to pass, and the official 310-question catalogue.
body:
The Einbürgerungstest is the knowledge test for German citizenship. The good news: every possible question is published in advance.

## The format

You answer 33 multiple-choice questions in 60 minutes. 30 questions are general questions about Germany, and 3 are about the federal state where you live.

## The pass mark

You need 17 correct answers to pass.

## Where the questions come from

The questions come from an official catalogue of 310: 300 general questions and 10 for each federal state. That means you can practise every question before the test.

## How to prepare

- Learn the general questions topic by topic
- Don't forget the 10 questions for your own state
- Read each option carefully: some look very similar
- Take timed mock tests until you score 25 or more

## Booking the test

You register at a test centre approved by the BAMF, often your local Volkshochschule. Bring your passport or ID card on the day.

Check the BAMF website for current rules and fees. Try a free mock test below.
